reactions: [Hacker News] Which is why they're already killing Argon, I guess. Though it seems weird, as Argon has only been available for a couple of weeks. They're going to run out of elements in less than two years at this rate.
[Hacker News] I just got access to it in chat. They seemed to have taken out argon. Used to be: 3.5 Flash lite. Hydrogen 3.1 pro Argon Carbon (locked) Now its just Auto Hydrogen Neon Carbon (locked)
[Hacker News] The new lineup is Hydrogen < Neon < Carbon. I think Argon has been superceded on the Pareto Front. Source: https://aistudio.google.com/docs/choosing-a-model

[Hacker News] 3 different models per lab was already confusing, 4 is really confusing. Very hard to figure out in what situation I would use Carbon, Argon, Neon or Hydrogen if I'm coming in brand new to Google AI.
